title: Count Good Triplets
summary: Given an array of integers, determine the count of triplets (i, j, k) where 0 <= i < j < k < array length, and the differences between the elements satisfy specific conditions involving absolute values and predefined thresholds.
statement: Given an array of integers, determine the count of triplets (i, j, k) where 0 <= i < j < k < array length, and the differences between the elements satisfy specific conditions involving absolute values and predefined thresholds.
hints: Enumerate every index triple in increasing order.
Increment only when all are satisfied.
The nested index ranges generate each legal i<j<k triple exactly once.
editorial: The nested index ranges generate each legal i<j<k triple exactly once.

tests.explanation: Exactly four ordered-index triplets satisfy all three distance limits.
No three positions satisfy both zero-distance adjacent-pair requirements.
